note: Eight cards to print, laminate with clear packing tape, punch a corner and put on a ring. These are the numbers you should not have to unlock a phone to remember.

cards.title: Water
rows: 1 gallon per person. 3 days minimum, 2 weeks better.
Filter through cloth or let it settle first. Then double the bleach.
8 drops per gallon clear (2 per quart). 16 drops if cloudy.
30 minutes. Should smell faintly of chlorine.
Scented, splashless or thickened bleach. Never mix with ammonia.
Fuel or pesticide contamination cannot be boiled out. New source.

cards.title: Fire
rows: Two armfuls of kindling before you strike anything.
Dry grass, birch bark, fatwood, dryer lint — fist-sized and airy.
Light low. Add bigger wood only when flames are steady.
Cleared ground, 10 ft from tents, no overhanging branches.
Fire indoors or in a tent. Carbon monoxide has no smell.
Water, stir, water again, back of hand near the ash.

cards.title: Signal
cards.biglabel: three fires, three blasts, three flashes
rows: Sight through the hole, catch the glare on your hand, aim at the target.
Three blasts. Cheaper than shouting and carries further.

cards.title: Severe bleeding
rows: Hard, directly on the wound. Do not lift to check.
Add gauze on top. Never remove a soaked dressing.
Deep junction wounds: stuff gauze in, press over the top for 3 min.
2–3 in above the wound, not over a joint. Tighten until it stops. Write the time.
Lay flat, keep warm, nothing to eat or drink.
Emergency services first, then work. Say 'severe bleeding'.

cards.title: First aid order
cards.biglabel: safety first, then in this order
rows: Do not become the second patient.
Breathing — look, listen, feel. Rescue breaths if trained.
Circulation — stop the bleeding, treat for shock.
Disability — responsiveness, pupils, signs of head injury.
Exposure — get them out of weather, check for other injuries.
This is a memory aid. Take a hands-on course.

cards.title: Food safety
cards.biglabel: fridge at or below 40°F · freezer at or below 0°F
rows: Perishable food left out over 2 hours gets thrown out. 1 hour above 90°F.
Keep the fridge shut. It holds about 4 hours; a full freezer about 48.
3–4 days in a fridge. No fridge, no leftovers.
Bulging, leaking or badly dented cans: discard without tasting.
Bulging lid, cloudy brine, mould or off smell: discard without tasting.
Bring leftovers to a full simmer, not just warm.

cards.title: Kitchen ratios
rows: 1 cup rice : 1¾ cups water. 18 min, lid on, 10 min rest.
2 cups flour : 2 tsp baking powder : ¾ tsp salt : 2 tbsp oil : ⅔ cup water.
1 L water : 6 level tsp sugar : ½ level tsp salt.

cards.title: Canning
rows: Acidify: 1 tbsp bottled lemon juice or ¼ tsp citric acid per pint. Double for quarts.
Whole tomatoes in water: 40 min pints, 45 min quarts at 0–1,000 ft.
Beans, corn, meat, soup: pressure canner only. No exceptions.
No flex or click after 12–24 hours. Unsealed jars go in the fridge.
Never taste a suspect jar. Boiling does not make it safe.
